decontamination_notes: Real fix from pallets/flask PR #5917, merged 2026-02-12, after model training cutoffs, so the specific fix is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit d3b78fd (src/flask + pyproject.toml + BSD LICENSE). Runs in the shared per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:flask-5928 (flask runtime deps preinstalled, flask itself removed; flask imported from the workspace via PYTHONPATH=src). The bug: when a view force-enables provide_automatic_options (via a view attribute or add_url_rule argument) while OPTIONS is not in its methods, the automatic OPTIONS handler was not installed. Hidden tests drive the public Flask test client and assert HTTP status / Allow header; never internal rule state. Run with -c /dev/null so the repo's pytest config is ignored.
